segments.title: Sea otters keep a FAVORITE rock
segments.say: Sea otters keep a favorite rock, tucked in a pocket under their arm.

segments.title: A pouch of loose skin
segments.say: It's a pouch of loose skin under the forearm. It holds the rock. It holds the snack.

segments.title: Then they SMASH lunch open
segments.say: Floating on their backs, they smash shellfish open with that rock.

segments.title: The densest fur of ANY mammal
segments.say: And their fur is the densest of any mammal. About one hundred thousand hairs per square centimeter.
